name: modern-blog-monorepo
description: Modern Blog monorepo powered by MERN backend and React frontend

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.clean: npm run clean:backend && npm run clean:frontend
scripts.clean:frontend: cd frontend && rm -rf node_modules build dist
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend-mern && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
